---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest something. Please include the problem, not only the solution.
title: "[request] "
labels: enhancement
---

**The problem you hit**

What went wrong, in your own project. This matters more than the proposed
fix — constraint 2 of this project's own anchor says new features must be
justified by an observed signal, and your experience is that signal.


**What you'd like instead**


**What you did instead** (a workaround, or nothing)


**Would this still matter to you in a month?**

An honest "probably not" is a genuinely useful answer.
